prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "best" personal injury attorney in Chicago, as the right choice depends on the specific details of your car accident claim, such as the severity of your injuries, insurance limits, and whether the case will settle out of court or go to trial.
Several prominent and highly rated personal injury law firms in Chicago handle car accident claims:

Contingency Fee: Most Chicago personal injury lawyers work on a contingency fee basis (you pay no upfront fees, and they only take a percentage if they win or settle your case). Briskman Briskman & Greenberg +3
Statute of Limitations: In Illinois, you generally have two years from the date of the accident to file a personal injury lawsuit (735 ILCS 5/13-202). Malman Law +2
Comparative Fault: Illinois follows a modified comparative rule, meaning you can recover compensation as long as you are 50% or less at fault for the crash. Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C. +2
